worktrees.pane.worktrees.lede: Each task’s own copy of your repo, and how long it stays on this computer.
worktrees.clean.label: Clean up
worktrees.clean.tip: Removes every worktree that’s been idle for a day or more and holds nothing of its own
worktrees.clean.ask.body: Branches stay, and replying to a task brings its folder back. Folders git ignores, like node_modules, go with them and setup doesn’t run again.
worktrees.cleanup.title: Clean up automatically
worktrees.cleanup.description: Removes the folder of a task left idle this long. A task whose PR is merged or closed goes at the next cleanup, a Done task after a day, and any idle one sooner if the disk runs low. Its branch stays, and replying to the task brings the folder back. Uncommitted work, kept worktrees, For later and open PRs stay.
worktrees.max.title: Keep at most
worktrees.max.description: Past this many tasks’ worktrees, the oldest idle ones go first, a few minutes after a new one. Left over folders don’t count. Ones in use, with uncommitted work, kept, For later or on an open PR stay, even over it.
worktrees.done.title: When a task is done
worktrees.done.description: What Mark done does with the folders it and what ran under it leave on disk. Remove still asks before one with uncommitted work goes.
worktrees.list.title: On disk
worktrees.filter.label: Show
worktrees.list.label: Worktrees on disk
worktrees.keep.left: A left over folder has no task to keep it
worktrees.remove.dirty.one: Its {count} uncommitted change can’t be brought back.
worktrees.remove.dirty.other: Its {count} uncommitted changes can’t be brought back.
worktrees.remove.unreadable: wisp can’t read what it holds, and anything uncommitted can’t be brought back.
worktrees.remove.left.body: No task uses this folder, so nothing brings it back.
worktrees.remove.left.dirty.one: No task uses this folder, so nothing brings it back, and its {count} uncommitted change goes with it.
worktrees.remove.left.dirty.other: No task uses this folder, so nothing brings it back, and its {count} uncommitted changes go with it.
worktrees.bring.title: Bring in
worktrees.bring.description: Worktrees another tool left in your projects. Each becomes a task on its own branch; nothing on disk moves.
worktrees.bring.detached: {count} with no branch can’t be brought in
worktrees.folders.holds.hint: The clean ones are gone. Tick one to remove it anyway, and what it holds goes with it.
worktrees.folders.hint: Their branches stay, and a follow-up brings a folder back.
worktrees.folders.hint.dirty.one: Their branches stay, and a follow-up brings a folder back. The one holding work goes only if you tick it.
worktrees.folders.hint.dirty.other: Their branches stay, and a follow-up brings a folder back. Ones holding work go only if you tick them.
worktrees.folders.loses.unreadable: Git can’t read it: what’s in it may be lost
worktrees.folders.loses.off-branch: Its commits off the branch will be lost
worktrees.folders.failed.n.one: Kept {count} folder that couldn’t be removed. {error}
worktrees.folders.failed.n.other: Kept {count} folders that couldn’t be removed. {error}
